data_facts_with_para.paragraph: The vendor reported fourth-quarter 2024 sales of 72.9bn Swedish krona (SEK) ($6.7bn), representing a like-for-like growth rate of 2%. And thanks to cost cutting, broader efficiency measures and a greater proportion of software product sales, Ericsson’s fourth-quarter margins improved, with the adjusted EBIT (earnings before interest and tax) margin hitting 13.1%, up from 10.3% a year earlier. The company’s board has also proposed an improved dividend payment to shareholders.

facts.fact_content: Adjusted EBIT margin hitting 13.1%, up from 10.3% a year earlier.
Share price took a near 9% hit to SEK88.84 on the Stockholm exchange.
